an7.68:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an7.68:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaparoparaññū ca.
an7.68:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaññū hoti? 3.
an7.68:2.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an7.68:2.4: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ jāneyya:
an7.68:2.5: suttaṃ geyyaṃ . . .abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ, na yidha dhammaññū ti vucceyya;
an7.68:2.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ jānāti:
an7.68:2.7: suttaṃ geyyaṃ . . . abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ, tasmā dhammaññū ti vuccati.
an7.68:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tassa tass' eva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti
an7.68:3.3: ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho' ti.
an7.68:3.4: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu tassa tass' eva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jāneyya
an7.68:3.5: ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho' ti, na yidha atthaññū ti vucceyya;

an7.68:3.7: ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho' ti, tasmā atthaññū ti vuccati.
an7.68:4.3: ‘ettako 'mhi saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya paṭibhānenā' ti.

an7.68:5.3: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu mattaṃ jāneyya cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ paṭiggahaṇāya, na yidha mattaññū ti vucceyya;

an7.68:6.3: ‘ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa. ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānāyā' ti.
an7.68:6.4: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu kālaṃ jāneyya
an7.68:6.5: ‘ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānāyā' ti, na yidha kālaññū ti vucceyya;
an7.68:6.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kālaṃ jānāti
an7.68:6.7: ‘ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānāyā' ti, tasmā kālaññū ti vuccati.
an7.68:6.8: Iti dhammaññū, atthaññū, attaññū, mattaññū, kālaññū.
an7.68:7.3: ‘ayaṃ khattiyaparisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇaparisā, ayaṃ gahapatiparisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā;
an7.68:7.4: tattha evaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ, evaṃ tuṇhībhavitabban' ti.
an7.68:7.5: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu parisaṃ jāneyya
an7.68:7.6: ‘ayaṃ khattiyaparisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇaparisā, ayaṃ gahapatiparisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā; tattha

an7.68:7.8: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu parisaṃ jānāti
an7.68:7.9: ‘ayaṃ khattiyaparisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇaparisā, ayaṃ gahapatiparisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā;
an7.68:7.10: tattha evaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ, evaṃ tuṇhībhavitabban' ti, tasmā parisaññū ti vuccati.
an7.68:7.11: Iti dhammaññū, atthaññū, attaññū, mattaññū, kālaññū, parisaññū.
an7.68:8.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno dvayena puggalā viditā honti:
an7.68:8.4: eko ariyānaṃ dassanakāmo, eko ariyānaṃ na dassanakāmo.
an7.68:9.2: eko saddhammaṃ sotukāmo, eko saddhammaṃ na sotukāmo.
an7.68:10.2: eko ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti, eko anohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
an7.68:11.2: eko sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti, eko sutvā dhammaṃ na dhāreti.
an7.68:11.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo sutvā dhammaṃ na dhāreti,
an7.68:12.2: eko dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati, eko dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhati.
an7.68:12.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhati,
an7.68:12.5: Yvāyaṃ puggalo dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati,
an7.68:13.1: Dve puggalā dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti:
an7.68:13.2: eko attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno, eko na attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno.
an7.68:13.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo na attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno,
an7.68:13.5: Yvāyaṃ puggalo attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno,
an7.68:14.1: Dve puggalā attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipannā:
an7.68:14.2: eko attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya, eko attahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca
an7.68:14.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno, no parahitāya,
an7.68:14.5: Yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca,
an7.68:15.1: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno dvayena puggalā viditā honti.
an7.68:16.1: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu puggalaparoparaññū hoti.
